notes.title: July 9 Update – Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p] **July 9 Update – Bug Fixes**[/p][p]Hi everyone! Thanks again for your support and feedback on *Echoveil: The Last Guest*. This update brings highly requested features and important fixes:[/p][p][/p][p] **Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- Fixed bug where player could get stuck behind the cabinet in the laundry room[/p][p]- Fixed starting area progression glitch[/p][p]- Added *subtitles for voice-overs* for better accessibility[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing! If you encounter more issues or want to share suggestions, feel free to post on the Steam forums. Your feedback means a lot! [/p][p]– Praveen Raj (Developer Of Echoveil The Last Guest)[/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed bug where player could get stuck behind the cabinet in the laundry room
